sourceFindings.meaning: The four original strings are QUDT/SAREF unit/property identifiers rather than any of the five observation-type codes in OGC SensorThings Table 12. The report selects only explicitly acknowledged original JSON numeric components.

Position 3 is named and defined as total dissolved solids, while the property description and sensor metadata say suspended solids calculated from conductivity. This report does not select that component or resolve the source conflict.
The retained public source does not establish a data reuse licence. The complete failed source queries and the separately licensed AD4GD document are not converted into a data licence.
The complete original Notion upload/download responses are retained. Original source HTTP status, method and headers were not exposed and remain null.
